behavioral_contract.inputs: Built execution container plus declared runtime/dependency requirements before task execution
behavioral_contract.environment_state: Exact task image/container and its OS/Python package-management policy
behavioral_contract.allowed_information: Task environment files, trusted task metadata, generic runtime probes; no solution/tests/verifier content
behavioral_contract.required_output_or_action: Produce a machine-readable execution-surface profile that identifies Python availability/version, PEP-668 external-management state, pip availability, actual venv creation+pip usability, and a safe package-install policy before builder execution
behavioral_contract.success_condition: A Stage-B/Stage-C plan cannot assume system pip on a PEP-668 surface; managed Python with usable venv is classified VENV_REQUIRED; unknown probe state fails closed before instruction/task execution
behavioral_contract.failure_condition: Material package-management difference between feasibility surface and actual task container remains undisclosed or a no-safe-route surface is authorized
behavioral_contract.terminal_consequence: Prevents untouched benchmark evidence from being spent on generic environment/package-policy failures rather than capability
behavioral_contract.verification_route: Independent runner tests plus exact-container profile emitted before instruction on future carriers
behavioral_contract.dependency_boundary: Deterministic runner/execution glue only; no cognition or task solution dependency
behavioral_contract.scope: Terminal-Bench fast-burst task containers and equivalent containerized qualification surfaces
